page_title: ANG 2-0 BRE | Angers v Brest 05/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.

90+5' 2 - 0 Referee Benoit Millot points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Ibrahima Niane (Angers) goes wild in celebration. Goal - 2:0! Lilian Rao-Lisoa laid the ball off to Ibrahima Niane (Angers), who unleashed a strong shot from close range into the back of the net, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
90+5' The Angers players joy may have been justified, because referee Benoit Millot is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
90+5' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Ibrahima Niane (Angers) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
90+2' Brest concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
87' Jordan Lefort (Angers) is able to continue to play.
86' Jordan Lefort (Angers) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
85' Brest can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
83' The referee allows time for a substitution. Mahdi Camara will be replaced by Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest).
81' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
80' Benoit Millot interrupts the game. One of the players from Angers won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
79' Ibrahima Niane (Angers) launches himself at a lofted pass, but his close-range header flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brest.
78' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
76' A substitution has been made. Esteban Lepaul goes off and Ibrahima Niane (Angers) comes on.
76' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Farid El Melali walks off the pitch to be replaced by Lilian Rao-Lisoa (Angers).
76' Alexandre Dujeux has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Pierrick Capelle (Angers) replacing Jean-Eudes Aholou.
75' The corner is bent into the box and met with a firm header by Mahdi Camara (Brest), but it's just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Angers will have a goal kick.
75' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
74' A cross from Mama Balde (Brest) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
74' Eric Roy has decided to make a change. Ibrahim Salah (Brest) replaces Ludovic Ajorque.
73' Substitution. Romain Del Castillo walks off the pitch and Romain Faivre (Brest) comes on as a substitute.
71' Emmanuel Biumla (Angers) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
68' The Brest players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
66' Substitution. Jim Allevinah makes his way off the pitch and Zinedine Ferhat (Angers) comes on as his replacement.
63' Here is a change. Abdallah Sima is going off and Eric Roy gives the last tactical orders to Mama Balde (Brest).
63' Here's the change. Hugo Magnetti leaves the pitch and Kamory Doumbia (Brest) comes on as a substitute.
62' Brest quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
59' The game is interrupted. Mahdi Camara (Brest) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
57' Carlens Arcus (Angers) was too forceful with his tackle and Benoit Millot interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
56' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
53' Benoit Millot interrupts the game. One of the players from Angers won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
51' Brest enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
48' Benoit Millot has a clear sight and sees a foul from Edimilson Fernandes (Brest).
47' Himad Abdelli (Angers) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Jean-Eudes Aholou (Angers) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Benoit Millot had an easy-decision to make.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' Massadio Haidara (Brest) sends a cross into the box, but Yahia Fofana comes off his line to gather the ball.
43' Esteban Lepaul (Angers) is first to react to a loose pass inside the box, but slices his shot just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brest.
42' It looks like Romain Del Castillo (Brest) saw red with that tackle. Benoit Millot won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
42' Massadio Haidara (Brest) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
41' Abdoulaye Ndiaye (Brest) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
39' Abdallah Sima (Brest) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Angers.
35' The Brest players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break. The ratio of the ball possession is 40:60.
34' Esteban Lepaul (Angers) makes a rough challenge and Benoit Millot blows his whistle for a foul.
33' Jim Allevinah (Angers) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
32' Jim Allevinah (Angers) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
31' Benoit Millot shows a yellow card to Massadio Haidara (Brest) for his blatant foul.
31' Good clearance! Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.
28' Edimilson Fernandes (Brest) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Angers.
26' Carlens Arcus (Angers) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Benoit Millot blows his whistle for a foul.
25' Corner kick. Farid El Melali (Angers) is ready to send the ball into the box.
25' Himad Abdelli (Angers) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
22' Abdallah Sima (Brest) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Yahia Fofana.
21' Massadio Haidara (Brest) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
19' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Esteban Lepaul (Angers) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
16' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Angers was in an offside position.
15' The Brest players are exchanging some short passes.
11' A player from Brest commits a rough challenge. Benoit Millot blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
9' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jim Allevinah (Angers) was quite harsh and Benoit Millot didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
6' 1 - 0 Goal - 1:0! Carlens Arcus tees up Esteban Lepaul (Angers) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom left corner and past Marco Bizot.

4' Jordan Lefort (Angers) bravely wins the ball from the corner but can't direct it on target, sending it well wide of the left post from near the penalty spot. The ball goes out of play and Brest will have a goal kick.
4' Farid El Melali (Angers) will take a corner kick.
3' Carlens Arcus (Angers) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Angers win a corner.

2' Mahdi Camara (Brest) is strong enough to get to the ball and produces a header from close range. Even though it was aimed precisely towards the middle of the goal, Yahia Fofana didn't have a hard time stopping the attempt as it wasn't powerful enough.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Brest will take the kick-off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
Benoit Millot was nominated as the referee for this game.
